frame: RAS millimetres (docs/ssb.md section 4); chart units are millimetres
note: written by tools/ssb-pipeline/uw/softtissue.py; normals point from the airway into the tissue

s.septal-mucosa.R.rule: chart (a, s) mm = RAS (A, S); r = RAS R of the surface at that (a, s); sagittal projection

unreliable.rule: chart cells whose surface samples span more than 1.0 mm in R (the surface folds across the cell: a spur, a deviation or a steep edge); a lookup there is approximate

s.septal-mucosa.L.rule: chart (a, s) mm = RAS (A, S); r = RAS R of the surface at that (a, s); sagittal projection

unreliable.rule: chart cells whose surface samples span more than 1.0 mm in R (the surface folds across the cell: a spur, a deviation or a steep edge); a lookup there is approximate
